text:
Alice: heads up — canary looks fine but embeddings quality is degrading on prod v2.4.2 for a subset of queries :frowning:
Ben: saw it in the dashboard too. which metric drifted?
Alice: embedding cosine mean down ~6% on the eval set, customer A reported exact-match fails for similarity search
deploy-bot: [alert] canary p95 stable, but model-quality-regression detected (embeddings-v2.4.2) — recommended action: investigate or pin
Carla: release notes for 2.4.2 mention changed tokenizer handling for embeddings. did docs mention backward-compatibility issues?
Ben: release notes were light — we pushed a changelog snippet but not the compatibility caveat. my fault.
Dinesh: is auto-rollback allowed here? we were in a restricted change window for EU at 09:00-11:00 UTC
deploy-bot: autopilot: rollback threshold exceeded for model-quality-regression. auto-rollback suppressed due to channel policy (release-window-exception)
Alice: so bot won't auto-revert because of the change window. we need a manual decision.
Eva: customer support has one active ticket flagging search results surfaced to a user in EU. legal is CC'd. we should minimize blast radius.
Ben: propose manual rollback to embeddings-v2.3.9 pinned for hosted and dedicated, while we patch tokenizer changes. timeline: 10-15m to cutover + verification
Carla: I'll take EU comms and draft the note for impacted customers. @dinesh can you handle APAC followup? timezone-wise we're about to go offline in ~2h
Dinesh: on it. i'll coordinate with on-call for morning in APAC.
Alice: steps i will run now:
Alice: ```
# pin model across hosted and dedicated
redwoodctl model pin embeddings --version 2.3.9 --scope hosted,dedicated
# re-route 100% traffic for embeddings-rerank -> 2.3.9
redwoodctl route set embeddings-rerank --model embeddings:2.3.9 --force
``` 
Ben: ok i'll watch the deploy logs. if anything blocks, abort and we escalate to SRE
deploy-bot: [action] manual pin requested by Ben. rolling pin to embeddings:2.3.9 (hosts: hosted,dedicated). ETA 12m. progress: 0/24 nodes
ops-bot: noticed: scheduled maintenance in us-west in 30m (non-blocking)
Carla: drafting comms: "We detected a regression in embedding similarity after the 2.4.2 update; we've rolled back to 2.3.9 while we validate a fix. Apologies for any disruption."
Eva: add link to support ticket and expected next update in 2 hours pls
Ben: deploy log: node 6 failed to apply pin (timeout). trying again.
Alice: re-run fencing on node 6, command: `redwoodctl node drain 6 && redwoodctl node apply-pin 6`
Ben: node 6 back. progress 24/24. routing flip complete.
deploy-bot: [success] pin and traffic reroute complete for embeddings-rerank -> 2.3.9. Observability: latency and token costs unchanged. Quality checks: synthetic eval suite passed (baseline), live drift metric trending back toward baseline
Alice: running smoke queries for the customer-reported workload now.
Eva: support notified customer A via private channel, flagged for ETA in 2 hours :white_check_mark:
Carla: EU comms sent to 3 affected accounts and posted in #customer-notices
Dinesh: APAC ops on call. i'll monitor overnight and wake if needed.
Ben: logging for postmortem: release notes omission caused confusion, tooling flag worked but change window prevented autopilot — consider adding an override path for severe quality regressions
Alice: agree. creating a small RFC for autopilot-exception on quality regressions with legal/ops approval
deploy-bot: [info] thread closed by manual action. archived run id: r-7101112222-rollback
Ben: thanks all — will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
